funds_data.description: The fund generally invests at least 80% of its total assets in the constituents of the index. The index consists of 30 equally weighted U.S.stocks from the Russell 1000 Index that represent all economic sectors within the S&P 500 Index and that represent dividend paying value stocks that deliver dividend cash flows across all market cycles.
